classification_notes.recommended: curated common 2.0 path with a concise checked example
classification_notes.advanced: stable application path shown after the common route
classification_notes.compatibility: maintained 1.x surface with a replacement or explicit retain decision
classification_notes.experimental: not covered by the stable compatibility promise
classification_notes.implementation: generic specialization support; use a named application facade

compatibility_notes.legacy-dense-matrix: The typed replacement is not a cast: convert with TDenseDoubleMatrix.FromIMatrix or ToIMatrix, which deep-copies. Typed storage uses SizeInt shapes, explicit kernels/factors/results, and documented views instead of the combined mutable IMatrix method surface.
compatibility_notes.legacy-sparse-matrix: TSparseDoubleMatrix constructs canonical CSR/CSC values returned as ISparseDoubleMatrix. TMatrixKitSparse remains an IMatrix-compatible mutable representation; conversion must enumerate/copy and must not be treated as a zero-copy CSR cast.
compatibility_notes.focused-bond-alias-unit: Retain FinanceLib.Bonds as a focused entry unit. Its public names are exact aliases of TFinanceKit, EFinanceError, and TFinanceKit amortization types, so retaining it has no numerical or ownership difference.
compatibility_notes.focused-npv-alias-unit: Retain FinanceLib.NPV as a focused entry unit. Its public names are exact aliases of TFinanceKit, EFinanceError, and TDoubleArray, so retaining it has no numerical or ownership difference.
compatibility_notes.pressure-facade-alias: TPressureKit remains a supported exact alias of EngineeringLib.FluidDynamics.TFluidDynamicsKit. The 1.9.7 rehearsal confirmed identical behavior, defaults, ownership, exceptions, numerical results, and dependency-neutral in-place packaging; new cross-fluid code may prefer the common facade, but no deprecation is approved.
compatibility_notes.pressure-error-alias: EPressureError remains a supported exact alias of EngineeringLib.Common.EFluidDynamicsError. The 1.9.7 rehearsal confirmed exception identity and dependency-neutral in-place packaging; no deprecation is approved.
compatibility_notes.velocity-facade-alias: TVelocityKit remains a supported exact alias of EngineeringLib.FluidDynamics.TFluidDynamicsKit. The 1.9.7 rehearsal confirmed identical behavior, defaults, ownership, exceptions, numerical results, and dependency-neutral in-place packaging; new cross-fluid code may prefer the common facade, but no deprecation is approved.
